entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A gothic horror plane whose cards draw on classic horror stories and tropes; werewolves, vampires and zombies stalk it by night.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: The plane of the Homelands set, which R&D considered Innistrad might be a later version of.

entities.name: Thraben Militia
entities.description: An angry mob of Thraben townsfolk hunting a monster that has killed.

entities.name: Grimgrin, Corpse-Born
entities.description: A creature composed of multiple corpses stitched together, the closest card to Frankenstein's Monster.

events.summary: The Thraben Militia, an angry mob, hunts a monster after it has killed and been spotted by a Thraben Sentry.
events.quote: The card is an angry mob on the hunt for a monster after it has killed, and been spotted by Thraben Sentry

relations.note: R&D discussed whether Innistrad was supposed to be Ulgrotha many years later, but decided against a callback.
relations.quote: R&D talked about if Innistrad was supposed to be Ulgrotha many years later
